quality_notes: Landfill variability research uses pre-existing monitoring data and inverse modelling; reported emission rates have high uncertainty and are not parcel-bound.
Onshore oil and gas packet records method selection and uncertainty research, not measured site totals.
Inverse dispersion packet records modelling concepts and findings from existing tracer-survey data; no PDF-derived values are used.
All three Wave135 sources are official Environment Agency HTML summaries with explicit source locators.
